hero.headline: Find out if solar is right for your home

hero.cta: Check if solar is right for you

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Drop a pin on your roof using the map or use your phone's GPS.
howItWorks.step2Title: Tell us about your roof and electricity bill
howItWorks.step2Desc: Trace your roof on the map or enter the size manually. Add your monthly bill.
howItWorks.step3Desc: See how much you could save, the right system size, and how long it takes to pay back.

trust.epraDesc: Our recommendations follow guidelines from the Energy & Petroleum Regulatory Authority of Kenya.
trust.pvgisDesc: We use EU PVGIS satellite data to measure sunlight at your exact location.
trust.noSignupDesc: Get your full report without creating an account or sharing your email.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.a1: Yes, completely free. We earn a small fee from verified installers only if you request quotes.
faq.a2: The sunlight estimate is within ±5% based on 20 years of satellite data. Actual costs depend on your specific roof and installer pricing.
faq.a3: Only if you ask for quotes by filling in your contact details at the end of the report. We never share your details without your consent.
faq.a4: All of Kenya. Sunlight data is available for every county.
faq.a5: PVGIS is a free scientific tool from the European Commission that uses satellite images to measure how much sunlight hits any location on earth.
